title: Affine pro-etale closed inverse image has an extra left adjoint
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the small pro-etale sites and fixed universes of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and the inverse image $i^{-1}$ of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. There exists a functor $i^{\mathrm{Sh}}_!:\operatorname{Sh}(Z_{\mathrm{proet}})\to\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})$ with natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(i^{\mathrm{Sh}}_!G,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(G,i^{-1}F)$ for all sheaves of sets $G$ on $Z_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].

source.place: Tag 09BL, lemma-closed-immersion-affines-apply, clause (3); its geometric input is Tag 09BK, lemma-closed-immersion-affines

proof.text: For $S=X,Z$, let $R_S$ be restriction to $S_{\mathrm{app}}=\mathcal B_S$. The inclusion is fully faithful because the basis is a full subcategory [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. Every full-site object has a basis cover, and every cover of a basis object has a basis refinement, by [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. Thus it is cover-dense and its topology is induced: a full-site covering sieve contains a basis covering refinement, while a basis covering is a full-site covering. In the fixed small skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], sets have all the required structured-arrow limits (compatible tuples in products). Apply [lem-pc-fppf-dense-sheaf-equivalence] with sets to obtain restriction equivalences $R_S$; choose quasi-inverses $E_S$, with $R_SE_S\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $E_SR_S\cong\mathrm{id}$.

Use the canonical $u,v$ of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-closed-site-functor-properties], with $v$ defined by the universal ring lift. Throughout, $i$ means the ordinary base-change morphism [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], not an unidentified morphism induced by $v$. Put $T=R_Z i^{-1}E_X$. The evaluation statement [lem-weil-pbc-affine-closed-inverse-image-evaluation] applies to this ordinary $i^{-1}$ and identifies $T(F)(V)$ with $E_X(F)(v(V))\cong F(v(V))$ for every weakly contractible $V$ in $Z_{\mathrm{app}}$; the last identification is the component of $R_XE_X\cong\mathrm{id}$ from step 1. All identifications are natural in $F$. The functor $T$ is an inverse image of a morphism of topoi on the basis categories: a right adjoint is $R_Xi_*E_Z$, since the Hom bijections for the two equivalences and $i^{-1}\dashv i_*$ compose to this adjunction. Equivalences preserve limits by their universal property, and $i^{-1}$ preserves finite limits, so $T$ does also.

source.place: Tags 09BK and 09BL first assertion and clauses (1),(2)

proof.text: For a weakly contractible $V$ in $Z_{\mathrm{app}}$, let $h_{v(V)}$ be the representable presheaf on $X_{\mathrm{app}}$ and $G_V=h_{v(V)}^\#$. For any sheaf $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{app}}$, the universal property [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] gives $\operatorname{Hom}(G_V,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(h_{v(V)},F)$. The general presheaf Yoneda bijection [lem-galois-yoneda-hom-bijection] identifies the latter with $F(v(V))$, naturally in $F$. Combining with step 2 gives $\operatorname{Hom}(G_V,F)\cong T(F)(V)$, with exactly the naturality required by the criterion in step 4. No subcanonicity assertion is needed.

source.place: Tag 09BL proof of (3); categories.tex Tag 001P; sites.tex Tag 00WH

proof.text: Take $E$ to be all weakly contractible objects of the chosen small skeleton of $Z_{\mathrm{app}}$, hence a set. By [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis-wcontractible-cover], every object of $Z_{\mathrm{app}}$ has a covering by objects of this $E$, weakly contractible in this very basis site. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-topos-lower-shriek-existence-on-covering-generators] with $\mathcal C=X_{\mathrm{app}}$, $\mathcal D=Z_{\mathrm{app}}$ and inverse image $T$. Step 2 gives the topos morphism, step 3 gives the representing $G_V$, and the cited cover theorem gives its covering hypothesis. Obtain $L:\operatorname{Sh}(Z_{\mathrm{app}})\to\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{app}})$ and $L\dashv T$.

source.place: Tag 09BL proof of (3); Tag 0990 affine S_app clause; sites.tex Tag 09YX

proof.text: Define $i^{\mathrm{Sh}}_!=E_XLR_Z$. For $G$ on $Z_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, full faithfulness of $R_X$, then $L\dashv T$, then $E_XR_XF\cong F$ and full faithfulness of $R_Z$, give $\operatorname{Hom}(E_XLR_ZG,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(LR_ZG,R_XF)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(R_ZG,TR_XF)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(R_ZG,R_Zi^{-1}F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(G,i^{-1}F)$. Each bijection is natural in $G,F$ by the equivalence and adjunction identities. This proves the required adjunction, with domain the Z-sheaves and codomain the X-sheaves.
